info.title: Service Booking & Management API
info.description:
REST API for the Service Booking mobile app.

**Authentication:** call `POST /auth/login`, copy `data.token`, press **Authorize** and paste the token (no `Bearer ` prefix).

**Response format:** every success is `{ success: true, message, data }`; every error is `{ success: false, message, errors? }`.

**Demo accounts (after `npm run seed`):** user `demo@kiculagbe.com` / `Demo@12345`, admin `admin@kiculagbe.com` / `Admin@12345`.

**v2:** register now sends a 6-digit **email OTP** (Nodemailer); login is blocked until the email is verified. Bookings can be paid with **Stripe** (PaymentIntent + PaymentSheet). Customers can **review** completed bookings. Admins manage requests, busy time, services and see **monthly statistics** under `/admin/*`.

post.summary: Register (sends a verification code by email)
post.description: Password rules: 8–72 characters, at least one letter and one number. Returns a JWT so the user is logged in immediately.

201.description: Code sent. The account stays unverified until the code is confirmed.

example.message: We sent a 6-digit code to demo@example.com
An account with this email already exists

403.description: Email not verified (a new code was sent)

example.message: Please verify your email. We sent you a new code.

post.description: JWTs are stateless: the client simply deletes its stored token.

put.description: Send `name`, `phone` or both. Send an empty `phone` to clear it. Email cannot be changed.

newPassword.description: 8–72 chars, a letter and a number

400.description: Current password incorrect, or new password equals the old one

get.description: Returns every slot of the business day (default 09:00–18:00, every 30 min) that fits the service duration. `available` is false for past slots and slots that overlap an existing pending/confirmed booking. Dates up to 30 days ahead are allowed.

400.description: Past date, date too far ahead, or invalid format

example.message: You cannot book a date in the past

post.description:
`startAt` must be the `startAt` of an available slot from the availability endpoint. The booking starts as `pending`.

Rejected with **409** if the slot is already taken, or if the user already has an overlapping booking.
